description: Ten years after leaving Knights Ridge and turning his old friends into characters in a successful novel, Nick Garrett comes home to teach a short college course and finds nearly every relationship he abandoned still waiting for an explanation. His return reopens questions about Hannah and her son Sam while old friendships, resentments and new romances pull him back into town life.

s01e01.description: Writer Nick Garrett returns to Knights Ridge after a decade away and discovers that his old friends still resent how he portrayed them, while Hannah's young son raises a far more personal question about what Nick left behind.

s01e02.description: Nick decides to stay in town and fights for a teaching job, while the Commander quietly investigates whether Sam could be his grandson and Eddie considers using Aubrey to get back at Nick.

s01e03.description: Nick uses advice from his own novel to help Sam approach a crush, Eddie and Janet begin seeing each other in secret, and Physical Phil tries to work up the nerve to invite Pizza Girl inside.

s01e04.description: Nick and Ronnie become suspicious of the Commander's private life, Phil finally has dinner with Pizza Girl, and Eddie learns that Big Cat has returned with unfinished business involving their circle of friends.

s01e05.description: Nick and Hannah wait through Sam's surgery as old feelings surface, while Phil retaliates against two men who harassed Pizza Girl and Eddie and Ikey each struggle to keep damaging relationships hidden.

s01e06.description: Aubrey forces Nick to confront his unresolved feelings for Hannah, Ray exposes Ikey and Alison's affair to Owen, and Phil tries to repair his relationship with Pizza Girl as the town's secrets stop staying private.
